svg.text: L5 Rename lineage: the R10000 map table, free list and active list beside the M1 rename stage
Left, Yeager 1996 redrawn with the paper's numbers. Right, the M1 from the knowledge base. Between them what Apple kept, changed and added.
RENO: move elimination at the map table
How the lineage tag is meant
move r3, r2 becomes r2 → p3
the load wakes on the add
free list, a FIFO of numbers
old destination logged, freed at retire
ready bits read at the queue
one active list becomes two queues
likely: structure matches field for field
